device: iPhone 15, iOS 26.x (or the newest release), Home Screen app; floor device (Q-10): tier mobile-low at 30 fps; operator Preview built with the synth world (QA build)

steps.instruction: Build one Preview with the synth world and QA flags (Preview builds carry no world on their own, DL-653): pnpm map:build -- --area synth && DV_WORLD=synth VITE_DV_QA=1 pnpm build && pnpm deploy:preview. Write the Preview URL into notes.json as previewUrl.

In Safari open the Preview URL, then Share > Add to Home Screen, and launch the app from the Home Screen icon (not from Safari). Open <preview>/?perf=1&tier=mobile-low&scenario=walk-civic-center&debug=1. The HUD must show 'mobile-low  webgl2'. After the world is up, __dvBridge.world.look().textures must read mode 'albedo', the four bound sets (asphalt, concrete, pavers, grass-dirt) and a format (ASTC4x4, ETC2 or RGBA8); write that object into notes.json as textures.

In the sky controls set the hour to 13:00 and the weather to clear, tick Freeze, and let walk-civic-center run to its end with the textures on (the default). The roads, the sidewalks, the paving and the grass must show worn asphalt, concrete slabs, pavers and grass-dirt in place of flat colour, and nothing may shimmer or stretch at the edge of a road. Tap Export and save perf.json and notes.json to docs/device-runs/M10d0/iphone15/. In notes.json record textureMB (look().textures.gpuBytes / 1048576), heapMB (the HUD's heap figure at the end of the walk) and your verdict (pass or fail, with a sentence).

Run walk-civic-center once more with __dvBridge.world.setLookLayer('textures', false) and write both median frame times and their delta (on minus off, ms) into notes.json as texturesDelta: { offMedianMs, onMedianMs, deltaMs }. If the on median is over the 30 fps budget (33.3 ms), say so; the fallback is the mode of the profile in config/world/surface-textures.json (data), never a larger budget.

Run pnpm perf:verify -- docs/device-runs/M10d0/iphone15/perf.json --tier mobile-low --checklist tools/ci/checklists/M10d0-iphone15.json: the median and p95 frame times, the frames over 50 ms, the render and triangle counts and the texture MB must pass at mobile-low with the textures on.
